claims.text: Cloister is the original heart of The Boca Raton and has welcomed guests since 1926.

findings.quote: The original heart of The Boca Raton, Cloister has been welcoming guests since 1926.

claims.text: The Boca Raton began in 1926 as an inn built by architect Addison Mizner.

findings.quote: The Boca Raton began in 1926 as a 100-room inn that legendary architect Addison Mizner built with funding from the Ritz-Carlton.

claims.text: Cloister is defined by Mediterranean-inspired architecture, secluded courtyards and lush tropical gardens.

findings.quote: Mediterranean-inspired architecture, secluded courtyards, and lush tropical gardens have created an unmistakable sense of place.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls Cloister the resort's most classically designed stay, with dark-wood furnishings and inconspicuous artwork.

findings.quote: The Cloisters is the most classically designed stay, with dark-wood furnishings and inconspicuous artwork

claims.text: The redesigned guestrooms honor the hotel's architectural character through a fresh, modern lens, with playful details.

findings.quote: The guestrooms honor the hotel’s architectural character through a fresh, modern lens, with playful details that capture the vibrant spirit of The Boca Raton.

claims.text: Cloister's central location puts the resort's historic Golf Club, its Racquet Club and Spa Palmera within easy reach.

findings.quote: Its central location puts some of the resort’s most celebrated experiences within easy reach, from our historic Golf Club and expansive Racquet Club to Forbes Five-Star Spa Palmera.

claims.text: Cloister is the closest of the resort's stays to its main amenities, like dining and shopping.

findings.quote: plus it’s closest to all the resort’s main amenities, like dining and shopping.

claims.text: Cloister guests have full resort access.
Cloister guests have access to the private amenities of The Boca Raton Club.

findings.quote: Access to the private amenities of The Boca Raton Club

claims.text: Cloister offers a fleet of bicycles.
Rooms have Molton Brown bath amenities.
Mizner Park, an outdoor district with a fine arts museum, shopping and dining, is about a five-minute drive north of the resort.

findings.quote: A five-minute drive northward gets you to Mizner Park, an outdoor entertainment district with a fine arts museum, high-end shopping, and chef-driven dining.

claims.text: Cloister features rotating art collections and fashion collaborations throughout.

findings.quote: Cloister is a place of discovery, with rotating art collections, fashion collaborations, and unexpected moments woven throughout.

claims.text: Cloister's rooms were newly redesigned in fall 2026.
Spa Palmera is an ode to the Alhambra Palace, with arches, stonework, mosaic tiles and a courtyard with a lap pool.

findings.quote: An ode to the Alhambra Palace, Spa Palmera brings the majesty and feel of the Moorish castle to Florida
replete with arches, stone work, mosaic tiles, and a lush courtyard with a tranquil lap pool.

claims.text: Two water taxis carry guests across Lake Boca Raton to the resort's private beachfront.

findings.quote: There are even two water taxis that transport guests to and from the Harborside location across Lake Boca Raton to the private beachfront.

claims.text: The resort's private beachfront is across Lake Boca Raton; water taxis carry guests there.

findings.quote: There are even two water taxis that transport guests to and from the Harborside location across Lake Boca Raton to the private beachfront.
